mike: quick flagseeing p99 jumps on dedicated-usw2-s4. looks like one tenant flooding NIC + causing kv-cache churn. can oncall take a look?

anya: sending metrics. slice=dedicated-usw2-s4; host=rack-3-host7; nic_tx_tail=1200Mbps; kv_miss=0.28; p99=198ms.

sre-oncall: taking immediate steps: 1) evict best-effort pods, 2) apply nic_shaper 25% on rack-3-host7, 3) toggle prefetch for tenant to off. ops-bot will monitor.

infra-bot: actions applied at 2025-02-12T08:12Z: evicted pods=8; nic_shaper=25%; prefetch=off (tenant=ingest-pro).

mike: after ops p99 -> 95ms. kv_miss down to 0.09. thanks.

anya: let's not leave this manual. propose short fingerprint rule: condition: kv_miss>0.2 && nic_tx_tail>1Gbps (5m). actions: route new allocs to fractional slice + prefetch=false + tag noisy. simple yaml: 
```
fingerprint:
 cond: kv_miss>0.2 && nic_tx_tail>1000
 actions: [fractional_dedicate, toggle_prefetch_false, tag:noisy]
```

sre-oncall: lgtm. but we need a cost sim first. if many tenants get flagged reserved cost grows. can we do 24h sim on top-10 noisy tenants?

mike: I'll run the sim and post numbers later today. follow-ups: sim (mike), metric for fingerprint_hits (anya), prefetch toggle API (infra).
